patterns: What is your return policy?

I want a refund for my purchase
How do returns work here?
responses: Our standard return policy gives you 30 days from the purchase date to return unworn items in their original packaging for a full refund or store credit.

patterns: Where is my order?

When will my package arrive?
Track my delivery please
responses: You can track your real-time shipment status anytime by pasting your Order Reference ID in our automated carrier portal! Most standard domestic deliveries take 2 to 4 business days.

patterns: What are your working hours?
When do you open in the morning?

Are you open on Sundays and weekends?
Business hours of flagship location
responses: Our flagship physical retail centers are open Monday through Saturday from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM, and Sundays from 10:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST.

patterns: How does the loyalty program work?

Can I apply my reward points?

Are there loyalty rewards for frequent buyers?
responses: Our VIP Royalty Program grants Gold tier members an automatic 15% discount across all newly dropped seasonal apparel collections, zero shipping fees, and 50 points per in-store facial check-in!

patterns: Do you ship internationally?

responses: Yes! We partner with global DHL express carriers to fulfill deliveries across over 85 international destinations with guaranteed customs duties calculation at checkout.

patterns: What payment methods do you accept?

Do you take credit cards and debit?

responses: We support all major credit and debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, PayPal, and 0%-interest split installment financing via Klarna and Afterpay!

Apparel fitting recommendations
responses: Our items fit true to modern standard sizing! You can view detailed shoulder, waist, and inseam inches directly on our interactive Product Scanner item diagnostics.

responses: Popular seasonal inventory is replenished every Tuesday morning! You can activate our AI restock alert badge on any sold out item page for instant SMS notification.

responses: Digital and physical embossed gift cards are available from $25 to $500! They never expire and can be applied seamlessly both online and at physical AI POS kiosks.
